paper_title: Searching for vector dark matter with an optomechanical accelerometer
notes: Projected sensitivity to vector B-L dark matter using a Si3N4 membrane + Be mirror optomechanical accelerometer. Main result (Fig. 2) is gB-L vs mDM over ~1e-13 to 1e-10 eV (fDM ~1-25 kHz). Data points are approximate reads from Fig. 2 for the centimeter-scale membranes (1-year integration); precise values are not tabulated in the text, so these are rough estimates near the resonance dips (~1e-23 to 1e-22). The paper also presents B-coupled dark photon projections (Fig. 4). This is a proposal/projection, not an observed limit. | Auto-corrected masses: 1/(eV→MHz) i.e. MHz→eV inverse (×2.418e+08, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=1.0e-03)|)
